compose:
x-common: &common
  restart: unless-stopped
  labels:
    team: core

services:
  web:
    <<: *common
    image: nginx:1.27
    depends_on:
      - api
    environment:
      PRICE: $$10
      API_URL: http://api:3000
    expose:
      - 80
  api:
    <<: *common
    image: ghcr.io/x/api:${TAG}
    command: ["node", "server.js", "--price=$$5"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: ${DB_URL}
      FROM_APP:
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
    expose:
      - "3000"
